whenTrue.content:
In this milestone, you'll learn how to export your transformations outside Grafana Cloud. 

After you've added transformations to your dashboard panels, you can export them as a CSV file.

To export the data transformations, complete the following steps:

1. Open your dashboard in edit mode.
1. Click **Queries** tab and click **Query Inspector** button.
1. Select the **Data** tab.
1. Expand the **> Data options** row.
1. Enable the **Apply panel transformation** option.

    The following image shows the browser market share table with the filter data by values transformation applied.

    ![Browser market share with transformations applied](/media/docs/learning-journey/data-transformations/export-transformations.png)

1. Click **Download CSV** button.

  A CSV file will be generated containing the data set with transformations.

whenFalse.content: After you've added transformations to your dashboard panels, you can export them as a CSV file.
In this section, you'll export your panel's transformed data as a CSV file.

blocks.content: Open an existing panel that has transformations applied in edit mode on your dashboard.

Do the following:
- Click **Inspect queries** in the editor pane footer.
- Select the **Data** tab.
- Expand **Data options**.
- Enable **Apply panel transformations**.
- Click **Download CSV**.
Check your downloads folder for the CSV file.

A CSV file containing the data set with transformations applied downloads to your machine.

In the next milestone, you'll wrap up this learning path.
